bugs.title: Worker "Việc đã ứng tuyển" shortcut did nothing when already on the dashboard
bugs.rootCause: Worker UserMenu used a plain same-route link; the dashboard read its section/modal intent once on mount, so a same-route click never re-fired.
bugs.fix: Added a `section` field to DashboardModalEventDetail + navigateWithIntent/handleNotificationClick handling; added useSectionFromQuery; worker dashboard applied section got id=worker-applications-section + scroll-mt-24 + a repeat-safe flash-ring (rAF) wired via useSectionFromQuery + useDashboardModalEvents.
tests: e2e/20-core-stability-6.spec.ts :: Part 1 — focuses the applied section while already on the dashboard (repeat-safe)

bugs.title: Lifecycle notifications could duplicate on repeat sync; notifications lacked a visible timestamp
bugs.rootCause: notificationStore.push had no dedupe; repeat lifecycle passes for the same event could push duplicates. Notification UI showed no date/time.
bugs.fix: Added optional dedupeKey to Notification + push() dedupe on (userId, dedupeKey). Added dedupeKeys to ApplicationExpired (Step 2b), ShiftStarted/ShiftEnded (worker+employer). Added shared formatLogDateTime (vi-VN, second:'2-digit') and rendered it (newest-first) on NotificationBell + DashboardNotificationCard.
tests: manual probe: rendered font-mono "HH:mm:ss DD/MM/YYYY" on bell + dashboard cards

bugs.title: No worker/employer wallet cash-out (withdrawal) path
bugs.rootCause: Wallet supported top-up only; there was no demo withdrawal action or store guard.
bugs.fix: Added UserWithdrawal WalletLedgerEntryKind + walletStore.withdraw(userId, amount, note) returning Result with INVALID_AMOUNT / INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE guards. Added WalletPanel allowWithdraw 'Rút tiền' action (shown when balance>0) + modal + notification (new UserWithdrawal NotificationKind). Added wallet.withdraw.* + wallet.kind.UserWithdrawal + notification.kind.UserWithdrawal i18n.
tests: e2e/20-core-stability-6.spec.ts :: Part 3 (worker withdraw + ledger, over-balance blocked, employer withdraw)

bugs.title: Employer could attempt a deposit with insufficient wallet balance
bugs.rootCause: simulateDeposit did not guard balance before mutating; an underfunded wallet could enter an inconsistent deposit state.
bugs.fix: Added INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE to SimulateDepositError; simulateDeposit now guards balance < depositAmount BEFORE any mutation (no ghost published shift). Added shift.create.error.INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE i18n. Updated 3 existing tests to fund wallets first.
tests: e2e/20-core-stability-6.spec.ts :: Part 4 (blocked when empty; succeeds after top-up)

bugs.title: Build type error: withdraw notification used a non-existent NotificationKind 'UserTopUp'
bugs.rootCause: Part 3 withdraw notification was authored with kind:'UserTopUp', which is not a member of the NotificationKind union — `next build` TypeScript check failed.
bugs.fix: Added a real 'UserWithdrawal' NotificationKind + notification.kind.UserWithdrawal i18n label; WalletPanel withdraw notification now uses kind:'UserWithdrawal'. Build is clean (28 routes).
tests: npm run build (TypeScript type-check passes, 28 routes)

confirmedNotABug.title: Worker shows two "Ca làm đã kết thúc" notifications
confirmedNotABug.finding: Only one is seeded; the second is generated for a DIFFERENT shift with a distinct dedupeKey. dedupeDuplicates: []. Not a duplication bug.

confirmedNotABug.title: Read-only probe reported bellHasTimestamp:false
confirmedNotABug.finding: Probe regex expected date-first (DD/MM/YYYY HH:mm:ss). vi-VN Intl renders time-first: "09:15:32 30/05/2026". Product code renders the timestamp correctly; the probe regex was wrong. Verified rendered font-mono texts on the bell + dashboard cards.
confirmedNotABug.evidence: node -e Intl.DateTimeFormat('vi-VN', ...).format → "09:15:32 30/05/2026"; probe-ts rendered "12:07:33 30/05/2026" on bell + cards
